title: Kill Lurbuk
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract to assassinate the Orc bard Lurbuk at the Moorside Inn in Morthal, then report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary for a leveled gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin and the Dark Brotherhood's contract handler at the Sanctuary.
I assign side contracts to fellow Brotherhood members.
Lurbuk was so hated that multiple Brotherhood contracts were placed on him; Astrid held a lottery to decide whose contract would be honored.

CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: I have given the contract to kill the bard Lurbuk in Morthal.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The contract on Lurbuk has been fulfilled and the leveled gold reward has been paid, ranging from 250 to 750 gold depending on the assassin's experience.
With Lurbuk dead, the lottery Astrid held to decide which of the multiple Brotherhood contracts on him would be honored has been resolved.
I may have additional side contracts available for any willing Brotherhood member.

base_facts: I am an Orc bard who performs at the Moorside Inn in Morthal.
My singing is widely considered terrible, which is why someone put a Dark Brotherhood contract on me.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been assassinated at the Moorside Inn, fulfilling the Dark Brotherhood contract on my life.
My death resolves the lottery Astrid held among the many who placed contracts to have me silenced for my terrible singing.

beats.comment: Player accepts the contract from Nazir to kill the bard Lurbuk in Morthal.
Lurbuk has been assassinated. The game advances to stage 20 upon his death.
Player reports back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collects the leveled gold reward.
